name: Ishigami Sae
source:
As [url=https://vndb.org/c59928]Yukari[/url]'s cousin, Sae used to hang out with him all the time. However, as the pair grew older, they drifted apart. Now reunited at Platinum, Yukari sees how much Sae has grown up. She's confident and beautiful, but she's developed in some indecent ways as well, and she can't wait to show him those, either.

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/580736-do-you-like-horny-bunnies/faqs/33784]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
